user.title: DB Storage Manager
user.description: Adds a DB Storage panel to the sidebar. Nothing is changed until you apply an action in the panel.

init.title: DB Storage Manager
init.description: How often to record the database size for the size-over-time chart (the size sensors update at the same time), and when the nightly retention job runs. The job only applies rules you created on the Entities tab; you can also turn it off and run it from your own automation with the db_storage_manager.run_retention action.

run_retention.name: Run retention rules
run_retention.description: Delete detailed states older than each entity's retention rule (set in the DB Storage panel), then repack the database. Long-term statistics are not touched.

legacy_retention_automation.title: Delete the old DB Storage retention automation
legacy_retention_automation.description: DB Storage now runs the nightly retention job itself and no longer maintains an automation. Version 1.0.5 and earlier created the automation {entity_id} ("DB Storage: nightly retention") in automations.yaml; it is no longer updated and would run the job a second time. Open it in Settings > Automations & scenes ({link}) and delete it. This message disappears after the next restart once it is gone.
